description: Spawners on classic_flat (surface y=-61), as vanilla's vehicle_log9.txt has them: a stone floor at y -61, cow, sheep, spider and creeper spawners (mobs bigger than a block one way) at x 0, 3, 6 and 9, y -60, z 60. Cameras: straight above each at x+0.5 -57.5 60.5 0 90, from the south at x+0.5 -59.5 62.5 180 0. With -McSpawnerSpin=0 the mobs hold still, as vanilla's do with only a spectator about.
